description: This file defines a custom ListView (TaskListView) and an adapter (TaskAdapter) for displaying tasks with accessibility support in an Android application. It manages accessibility events and provides content descriptions for assistive technologies.

classes.name: TaskListView
classes.description: A custom ListView that adds accessibility event records with priority information when child items send accessibility events.

classes.name: TaskAdapter
classes.description: An adapter that provides views for list items, setting content descriptions and managing accessibility information for each task row.

methods.name: onRequestSendAccessibilityEvent
methods.description: Handles accessibility events from child views, adding a record with the task's priority.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses list item views, setting labels, checkboxes, and content descriptions for accessibility.
